en.description:
Nano Race - Probably the World's Smallest Racing Game!

Experience the thrill of racing in the palm of your hand with this unique Apple Watch exclusive game. Race against AI on a tiny but challenging nano-sized track, where every millisecond counts!

Features:
• Precise steering control using the Digital Crown
• Boost activation with screen tap or Double Pinch gesture (on supported devices)
• Race against a smart AI opponent
• Day and Night modes with dynamic lighting
• Three difficulty levels: Easy, Hard and Expert
• Customizable number of laps
• Precise collision physics
• Drift mechanics for skilled cornering
• Sleek, minimalist design

Master the Digital Crown for perfect racing lines and time your boosts strategically using touch or gesture controls. Challenge yourself in this micro-sized racing experience. Can you beat the AI in this nano-scale speedway? Perfect for quick gaming sessions on your watch!

The smallest racing game you'll ever play - but packed with action!

https://lithium.is/privacy-policy/
https://lithium.is/terms-of-use/
en.releaseNotes: Compatibility and stability improvements for watchOS 26
